explanation: This pole fires retrospectively when the preceding context (often 50+ tokens back) contains deontic, eligibility or transactional language: permission or obligation (deontic can/may/must/shall/have to, will-be/have-been passives like will be notified/given/presented), entitlement or formal status assignment (entitled, eligible, registered, listed, designated, assigned, available), or transactional inclusion/exclusion terms (fee, number, permit, discount, subscription, only, without, No/not in a rule). It fires in any register containing such terms, including how-to, news, sports, hotel, casino, email, poetry and fiction passages, with activation staying elevated across the passage onto neutral tokens. It sits near zero on concrete action, perception, descriptive or conversational text with no permission/obligation/eligibility/transactional terms, including non-deontic uses of the same modals (ability can, epistemic must, possibility may/might, plain future will) and plain negation.
